facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
proving zero energy before intrusive work

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of gravity energy at ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on ML-3201, M-3201 and VT-3201 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 15 September 2010 a hazard report was recorded on ML-3201, M-3201 and VT-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
